description: This file contains configuration utilities and environment variable handling for setting up database connectivity, CORS policies, and application settings in a backend project.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A dataclass that encapsulates the application configuration loaded from environment variables, including database URL, JWT settings, token expiration, and CORS policies.

methods.name: str|None _get_env(name: str, default: str | None = None)
methods.description: Utility function for retrieving environment variables with an optional default value.

methods.name: str|None _build_postgres_url_from_components()
methods.description: Constructs a Postgres database URL from individual environment variables if a full URL isn't provided.

methods.name: list[str] _resolve_cors_allow_origins()
methods.description: Parses environment variables to determine the list of allowed CORS origins.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Main function that loads and validates application configuration from environment variables, returning a Settings object.

ctags.name: _get_env
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_env(name: str, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:$/
